mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_info (id, group_name, user_id, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{groupName}, #{userId}, 1)
INSERT INTO group_template (id, group_id, template_id, status, `order`) VALUES (#{id}, #{groupId}, #{templateId}, 1, #{order})
mapper.select: SELECT id, group_name, user_id FROM group_info WHERE user_id = #{userId} and status = 1

select gt.id, gt.template_id, t.name, CASE WHEN t.leader_id = 'default' THEN 1 ELSE t.status END as status, t.leader_id, gt.`order`, CASE WHEN tp.status = 1 THEN true ELSE false END as pinned, tp.pinned_time from group_template gt join template t on gt.template_id = t.id and (t.status = 1 or (t.leader_id = 'default' and t.status != 2)) left join template_pin tp on gt.id = tp.group_template_id and tp.user_id = #{userId} where gt.group_id = #{groupId} and gt.status = 1 order by CASE WHEN tp.status = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, tp.pinned_time DESC, gt.`order`

select gt.id, gt.template_id, t.name, CASE WHEN t.leader_id = 'default' and t.status != 2 THEN 1 ELSE t.status END as status, t.leader_id, gt.`order` from group_template gt join template t on gt.template_id = t.id where gt.group_id = #{groupId} and gt.status = 1 order by gt.`order`

#{groupTemplateId}

select gt.id, gt.group_id, gt.template_id, t.name, CASE WHEN t.leader_id = 'default' THEN 1 ELSE t.status END as status, t.leader_id from group_template gt join template t on gt.template_id = t.id and (t.status = 1 or (t.leader_id = 'default' and t.status != 2)) where gt.id = #{groupTemplateId} and gt.status = 1
select t.* from group_template gt join template t on gt.template_id = t.id and (t.status = 1 or (t.leader_id = 'default' and t.status != 2)) where gt.id = #{groupTemplateId} and gt.status = 1
select id, group_id, template_id from group_template where template_id = #{templateId} and status = 1
